quarterly_data.signal: Microsoft's FY27 Segments and Investor Metrics presentation: beginning in fiscal year 2027 Microsoft reports two segments, Agents and Infra (the Microsoft Cloud, productivity and server licensing, and consulting and support businesses) and Devices and Consumer (Windows, XBOX and advertising). As restated, Agents and Infra revenue was $268,127 million in fiscal year 2026 versus $218,783 million in fiscal year 2025, including $74,576 million in Q4 of fiscal year 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Agents and Infra revenue (restated) $268,127 million fiscal year 2026 vs $218,783 million fiscal year 2025; Q4 fiscal 2026 $74,576 million

quarterly_data.signal: The same presentation discloses restated revenue for Azure under a NEW metric definition that replaces the previously reported 'Azure and other cloud services' (GitHub cloud and other developer cloud services and Security Copilot moved to Microsoft 365 commercial cloud; Healthcare and Life Sciences cloud moved to Industry solutions cloud), so these figures are not directly comparable with earlier 'Azure and other cloud services' disclosures: $101,938 million in fiscal year 2026 versus $72,610 million in fiscal year 2025, with $22,384 million, $24,129 million, $26,008 million and $29,417 million in Q1 to Q4 of fiscal year 2026. Restated Azure revenue growth was 42% in Q4 and 40% for fiscal year 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Azure revenue (restated) $101,938 million fiscal year 2026 vs $72,610 million fiscal year 2025; Q4 fiscal 2026 $29,417 million; restated Azure growth 42% (Q4), 40% (fiscal year 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Microsoft mechanically adjusted its FY27 Q1 outlook, as provided on July 29, 2026, to the new structure: Agents and Infra revenue of $75.15 to $75.75 billion and Azure revenue growth (updated Azure definition) of 44% to 45% in constant currency, with FX expected to decrease revenue by less than 1 point. The total company outlook and the capital expenditures outlook are unchanged.
